p51: It was through that brief meeting that Hestia instantly knew what Loki's aim was. There has been recent news that the Loki Familia is going on an expedition to explore the Deeper Floors of the Dungeon. So of course, there have been a lot of preparations going on.
p52: And it's because of this, Loki saw Sora as a perfect member to recruit to her expedition. Hephastois mentioned how some of her Familia members are being recruited for the expedition as well, so Loki saw fit to recruit Sora as well.
p53: But Hestia knew Loki's game here. Knowing that Goddess, she wouldn't even dream of swallowing her pride and asking her directly to have Sora join her Familia's expedition. Instead, she's making it seem like it's her Familia being interested in Sora and having them ask her in her stead. Loki must've worked around the issue of not giving a direct order by asking someone in her Familia, a high rank member, to ask the lower ranked member to search for Sora. This way, Loki could avoid being looked at as someone who's asking for Sora's help.

p55: There's no chance in hell that she is going to have Sora join that expedition.
p56: For one, she's not going to give Sora to Loki out of spite, given her distaste for Loki.
p57: But the second and most important reason is having Sora avoid the Loki Familia entirely and put him into hiding.
p58: She has a pretty good grasp on Sora. Sora wouldn't hesitate on helping others, even if there is no benefit to him. If the Loki Familia simply asked for his help or gave some sob-story or some kind of small legitimate reason, Sora would probably help them out in a heartbeat. And that would mean Sora practically begging or asking her to join Loki's expedition, which meant Sora playing right into Loki's hands.
p59: And if Sora joined the Loki expedition, it defeats the whole purpose of Sora trying to remain inconspicuous. Knowing Sora, the boy will immediately throw caution to the wind when it comes to helping others. Sora is too charitable to let anything bad befall upon others, meaning he'll show off more than what he's supposed to do. Not to mention the Heartless will force Sora's hand in revealing his other abilities.
p60: And the moment he does, Loki and her Familia will discover how truly abnormal Sora is. And in turn, will spread even further to other Familias and Gods. And that alone is asking for a disaster.
p61: Despite the damage already being done on Loki knowing that Sora is an abnormal Level 1, Hestia could still salvage the situation the best she could. And what better way is there than to have Sora go into hiding for a while and avoid Loki's active recruitment.
